## Steps to reproduce

1. Which suite, and which connection settings (server URL scheme, site, TLS bundle yes/no).
2. What you clicked or which API call you made.
3. What happened.

## Connection test

Paste the per-stage readout from Settings → Test connection, if relevant.

## Logs

Attach the backend console output and, for a run, the exported JSON results. Remove all
Personal Access Tokens, API keys and internal hostnames before attaching.
